annotations.title: Track an LLC or nonprofit formation order

description: Reports where an LLC or nonprofit formation order is, from its orderId and trackingToken (returned when an agent checks the order out, and carried in the founder's order-tracking link): its phase (awaiting payment, awaiting the founder's emailed confirmation, in Corpus's review, filing, submitted to the state, accepted by the state, completed), a dated milestone list, the state's confirmation number once the filing is submitted, and the certificate URL once it exists. filingSubmitted is the only field that means the state has the filing. Read-only; no API key; free, does not consume credits.

orderId.description: The order's id, as the checkout result or the tracking link gives it.

trackingToken.description: The order's tracking token, returned with the orderId.

name: formation.status

isError.description: True when the tool could not complete successfully.

text.description: Human-readable tool result (also mirrored in content[].text).
